_comment: ISS-683 — opt-in browser MCP for a human running /forge-test or /forge-verify-live interactively. Not auto-loaded, and nothing dispatched carries it: a job gets only the MCP servers its project's granted integrations produce (packages/core/src/jobs/resolve-job-mcp-servers.ts). Layer it explicitly: `claude --mcp-config .forge/verify-mcp.json --mcp-config .mcp.json`. Secret-free by design — safe to commit.
